iran_nuclear.notes: Iran nuclear lane is easing but still critical. iran_conventional.name: IRAN WAR

The best canonical fit is Hormuz restricted/not stopped; no zero-flow or waterway-obstruction signal is promoted

israel_lebanon.name: ISRAEL-LEBANON
israel_lebanon.notes: Israel-Lebanon remains at ceiling pressure. AP, NBC, PBS, BBC and Reuters 7-day fallback show a renewed halt in fighting after intensified Israel-Hezbollah exchanges, with reported casualties and severe truce strain. Combat-breach and diplomatic-channel signals remain active but are aging toward expiry without fresh 24h corroboration

turkey.name: TURKEY-NATO
turkey.notes: Turkey-NATO remains quiet. Seven-day fallback returned general NATO force-posture and regional diplomacy items but no Turkey-specific operational trigger, official strategic-weapons rhetoric, or configured weapon-firing indicator

india.name: INDIA-PAKISTAN
india.notes: India-Pakistan remains elevated on rhetoric only. CNBC, MSN, Hindustan Times, Firstpost and Times of India repeat Pakistani war-threat language around the Indus Waters dispute. No verified immediate force movement or cross-border combat threshold surfaced

russia.name: RUSSIA-NATO
russia.notes: Russia-NATO direct lane remains critical before Ukraine spillover and imminent after coupling. china.name: CHINA-TAIWAN
china.notes: China-Taiwan remains elevated. Focus Taiwan, Anadolu, Taipei Times, Nikkei and UA.NEWS report Taiwan immediate-readiness drills against a possible invasion scenario. No live blockade, amphibious breakout, or official strategic-weapons language surfaced

north_korea.name: DPRK

russia_ukraine.name: RUSSIA-UKRAINE

pakistan_afghanistan.name: PAKISTAN-AFGHANISTAN
pakistan_afghanistan.notes: Pakistan-Afghanistan remains imminent but slightly softer. sudan.name: SUDAN

israel_palestine.name: ISRAEL-PALESTINE
